string.name: hud_ra_label
string.translation_description: Map-HUD row label: right ascension of the point at the centre of the screen. Standard astronomy abbreviation; keep short.

string.name: hud_alt_label
string.translation_description: Map-HUD row label: altitude (angle above the horizon) of the point at the centre of the screen. Keep short.

string.name: hud_fov_label
string.translation_description: Map-HUD row label: the field of view (how many degrees of sky the screen spans). Keep short.

string.name: hud_correction_label
string.translation_description: Map-HUD row label for the manual sensor-alignment correction the user set by dragging. Keep very short.

string.name: hud_correction_reset
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the small button that clears the manual sensor-alignment correction back to zero.

string.name: hud_fov_locked
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the small lock icon shown next to the field-of-view readout while the camera controls the zoom in through-camera mode.

string-array.name: hud_cardinal_directions
string-array.translation_description: The sixteen compass-point abbreviations, clockwise from north, used as the azimuth suffix in the map HUD (e.g. N, NNE, NE...). Translate to the locale\'s conventional compass abbreviations.

string.name: layer_deep_sky
string.translation_description: Toggle label for the layer showing deep-sky objects such as galaxies and nebulae.

string.name: layer_satellites
string.translation_description: Toggle label for the layer showing artificial satellites such as the International Space Station.

string.name: layer_param_pass_alerts
string.translation_description: Label for the setting that turns on a notification shortly before a satellite passes overhead.

string.name: layer_param_pass_alerts_description
string.translation_description: Explains what the pass-alert setting does: a single notification before the best visible pass of the night.

resources.string: Meddela mig före den bästa synliga passagen varje natt

string.name: layer_param_eclipse_alerts
string.translation_description: Label for the setting that turns on a notification before a lunar eclipse begins.

string.name: layer_param_eclipse_alerts_description
string.translation_description: Explains what the eclipse-alert setting does: a single notification before a lunar eclipse starts.

resources.string: Meddela mig innan en månförmörkelse börjar

string.name: layer_param_altaz_grid_density
string.translation_description: Label for the alt/az grid's line-count setting.

string.name: layer_param_altaz_grid_density_coarse
string.translation_description: Option label for the alt/az grid's sparsest setting: 8 azimuth lines, 45 degrees apart.

string.name: layer_param_altaz_grid_density_coarse_desc
string.translation_description: Explains the coarse alt/az grid density: 8 azimuth lines, matching the 8 compass points.

string.name: layer_param_altaz_grid_density_medium_desc
string.translation_description: Explains the medium alt/az grid density: 12 azimuth lines, 30 degrees apart.

string.name: layer_param_altaz_grid_density_fine
string.translation_description: Option label for the alt/az grid's densest setting: 24 azimuth lines, 15 degrees apart.

string.name: layer_param_altaz_grid_density_fine_desc
string.translation_description: Explains the fine alt/az grid density: 24 azimuth lines, matching the celestial grid's meridian count.

string.name: satellites_no_data
string.translation_description: Explanation shown when satellite orbital data has not been downloaded yet and so no satellites can be drawn.

resources.string: Satellitpositioner behöver en internetanslutning för att uppdateras.

string.name: satellites_refresh
string.translation_description: Button that tries to download satellite orbital data now.

string.name: satellites_retry_soon
string.translation_description: Shown instead of a Refresh button when satellite data was just requested and cannot be requested again for a few minutes.

string.name: satellites_retry_within_hour
string.translation_description: Shown instead of a Refresh button when satellite data cannot be requested again for up to an hour.

string.name: satellites_retry_hours
string.translation_description: Shown instead of a Refresh button when satellite data cannot be requested again for several hours.

string.name: satellites_retry_tomorrow
string.translation_description: Shown instead of a Refresh button when satellite data cannot be requested again until the next day.

string.name: satellites_retry_days
string.translation_description: Shown instead of a Refresh button when satellite data cannot be requested again for several days.

string.name: layer_grid
string.translation_description: Toggle label for the layer showing the right ascension / declination grid.

string.name: layer_altaz_grid
string.translation_description: Toggle label for the layer showing the altitude/azimuth (horizontal) coordinate grid, for naked-eye or manual alt-az mount observers.

string.name: layers_sheet_title
string.translation_description: Title of the bottom sheet listing sky map layers the user can show or hide.

string.name: layers_group_objects
string.translation_description: Layers-sheet group header for layers that draw sky objects (stars, planets, deep-sky objects).

string.name: layers_group_reference
string.translation_description: Layers-sheet group header for reference elements drawn over the sky (coordinate grid, horizon, ecliptic).

string.name: layers_group_display
string.translation_description: Layers-sheet group header for display settings that change how the sky is rendered rather than what is drawn.

string.name: show_layers
string.translation_description: Accessibility description and label for the button opening the layer-visibility sheet, which holds the layers that do not fit on the rail plus display options.

string.name: more_button
string.translation_description: Accessibility label and tooltip for the map-screen button (three vertical dots) opening the overflow menu of further destinations such as Gallery and Settings.

string.name: switch_to_manual
string.translation_description: Tooltip and accessibility label for the button that switches the map from auto (sensor-driven) mode to manual (drag) mode.

string.name: switch_to_auto
string.translation_description: Tooltip and accessibility label for the button that switches the map from manual (drag) mode to auto (sensor-driven) mode.

string.name: layer_hud
string.translation_description: Layers-sheet Display toggle that shows the heads-up readout of where the phone is pointing (compass direction and altitude) over the star map.

string.name: layer_camera
string.translation_description: Layers-sheet Display toggle that shows the live rear-camera image behind the star map, so the drawn sky overlays the real one.

string.name: layer_camera_needs_sensors
string.translation_description: Subtitle explaining why the through-camera toggle is disabled: the device has no usable motion sensors, and the mode needs the map to follow where the phone points.

resources.string: Kräver rörelsesensorer som den här enheten saknar

string.name: ar_exposure_slider
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the slider adjusting the camera\'s exposure compensation while through-camera mode is on.

string.name: ar_dimmer_slider
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the slider dimming the camera image behind the star map while through-camera mode is on.

string.name: ar_iso_slider
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the temporary developer slider setting the camera\'s manual ISO sensitivity in through-camera mode.

string.name: ar_shutter_slider_label
string.translation_description: Very short label for the temporary developer slider setting the camera\'s manual shutter (exposure) time in through-camera mode.

string.name: ar_shutter_slider
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the temporary developer slider setting the camera\'s manual shutter (exposure) time in through-camera mode.

string.name: share_button
string.translation_description: Overflow-menu row that captures the current sky view as an image and opens the system share sheet.

string.name: share_shutter_button
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the round shutter button that captures and shares the current through-camera view.

string.name: location_button
string.translation_description: Button on the map screen that opens the location management sheet

string.name: gallery_button
string.translation_description: Map-screen menu item that opens a gallery of photographs of celestial objects. Not the user\'s own photos - these are catalog images from sources such as NASA and ESA.

string.name: whats_new_button
string.translation_description: Map-screen menu item that opens the What's New and Credits screen

string.name: widgets_button
string.translation_description: Map-screen menu item that opens the list of home-screen widgets the app offers

resources.string: Verklig storlek på himlen vid alla zoomnivåer. Planeter är bara prickar tills du zoomar in ordentligt.
Storleken baseras på himlakroppens verkliga storlek, inte hur stor den ser ut. Lätt att se vid alla zoomnivåer.
Håller en fast storlek på skärmen när du zoomar, och växlar sedan till verklig storlek.

string.name: search_hint
string.translation_description: Placeholder text in the search field showing example search targets.

string.name: search_coordinates_hint
string.translation_description: Helper text under the search field showing that celestial coordinates (right ascension and declination) can be typed directly, with two example formats.

string.name: search_go
string.translation_description: Button that starts navigating the sky map toward the typed search target.

resources.string: Inga resultat hittades. Kanske är objektet inte synligt just nu.

string.name: search_target_looking_message
string.translation_description: Status shown while the user is being guided toward a search target. %1$s is the object name.

string.name: search_target_found_message
string.translation_description: Status shown when the search target has been found and is centered on screen. %1$s is the object name.

string.name: time_travel_visiting
string.translation_description: Readout in the time travel dialog showing the currently chosen destination date and time. %1$s is the formatted date and time.

string.name: time_travel_pick_date
string.translation_description: Button in the time travel dialog that opens a date picker.

string.name: time_travel_pick_time
string.translation_description: Button in the time travel dialog that opens a time picker.

string.name: time_travel_select_event
string.translation_description: Placeholder hint for the dropdown list of popular astronomical events in the time travel dialog.

string.name: time_travel_go
string.translation_description: Button that starts time travel to the chosen date.

string.name: time_travel_return
string.translation_description: Player button that ends time travel and returns the map to the present.

string.name: time_travel_now
string.translation_description: Time travel picker entry that resets the destination to the present moment.

string.name: time_travel_lunar_eclipse_aug_2026
string.translation_description: Name of an astronomical event in the time travel picker. Keep the date format suitable for your locale.

resources.string: Solen kommer inte att gå ned under de nästa 24 timmarna på din nuvarande plats.

string.name: time_travel_start_message
string.translation_description: Toast message when time travel starts toward a chosen destination. %1$s is the formatted destination date and time.

string.name: satellite_next_pass
string.translation_description: Heading above the next visible pass details on a satellite\'s info card.

string.name: satellite_pass_when
string.translation_description: When and how high the next satellite pass will be. %1$s is a time, %2$s is a compass direction, %3$d is an angle in degrees.

string.name: satellite_pass_magnitude
string.translation_description: How bright the satellite will be at its peak. %1$.1f is a brightness magnitude.

string.name: satellite_pass_shadow
string.translation_description: Tells the user the satellite will fade out mid-pass when it enters the Earth\'s shadow. %1$s is a time.

resources.string: Försvinner in i jordens skugga kl. %1$s

string.name: satellite_no_pass
string.translation_description: Shown on a satellite info card when no visible pass is coming up in the next two days.

resources.string: Inga synliga passager de närmaste dagarna

string.name: satellite_pass_unknown
string.translation_description: Shown on a satellite info card when the downloaded orbit data is too old to predict pass times reliably.

resources.string: Banexemplaren är för gamla för att förutsäga passager

string.name: object_info_eclipse_title
string.translation_description: Heading above the next lunar eclipse details on the Moon\'s info card.

string.name: object_info_no_eclipse
string.translation_description: Shown on the Moon\'s info card when no lunar eclipse is coming up in the searched time range.

resources.string: Ingen månförmörkelse att vänta den närmaste tiden

string.name: object_info_eclipse_greatest
string.translation_description: The next lunar eclipse\'s type and greatest-eclipse date/time. %1$s is a localized eclipse type like \'Total lunar eclipse\', %2$s a date, %3$s a time.

string.name: object_info_eclipse_totality
string.translation_description: The start and end time of totality during a total lunar eclipse. %1$s and %2$s are times.

string.name: object_info_image_credit
string.translation_description: Attribution line under the object\'s photo; %1$s is the credited source, e.g. NASA/ESA

string.name: object_info_fun_fact
string.translation_description: An interesting trivia line on the object info card; %1$s is the fact text

string.name: object_info_spectral_class
string.translation_description: Label for a star\'s spectral classification (e.g. G2V) on the info card

string.name: object_info_rises
string.translation_description: Label on the info card for the time the object next rises above the horizon at the user\'s location

string.name: object_info_sets
string.translation_description: Label on the info card for the time the object next sets below the horizon at the user\'s location

string.name: object_info_always_above_horizon
string.translation_description: Info-card line shown for a circumpolar object that never sets at the user\'s location

resources.string: Alltid över horisonten på din plats

string.name: object_info_always_below_horizon
string.translation_description: Info-card line shown for an object that never rises at the user\'s location

resources.string: Alltid under horisonten på din plats

string.name: object_info_also_known_as
string.translation_description: Label on the info card above the object\'s alternative names (aliases and catalog designations), e.g. M31 and NGC 224

string.name: object_info_see_also
string.translation_description: Heading above links to related celestial objects on the info card

string.name: object_info_close
string.translation_description: Button that closes the object info card

string.name: tonight_lunar_eclipse_total
string.translation_description: Tonight-widget row: a total lunar eclipse is starting soon or under way

string.name: tonight_lunar_eclipse_partial
string.translation_description: Tonight-widget row: a partial lunar eclipse is starting soon or under way

string.name: tonight_lunar_eclipse_penumbral
string.translation_description: Tonight-widget row: a penumbral lunar eclipse is starting soon or under way

resources.string: Plats är inte tillgänglig på denna enhet

string.name: location_map_content_description
string.translation_description: Accessibility description of the static map image showing the current location of the user

string.name: location_permission_dialog_title
string.translation_description: Title of the dialog that requests location permission from the user. The permission is optional - the app works fully without it - and the title must not imply otherwise

string.name: location_permission_dialog_message
string.translation_description: Body text of the dialog requesting location permission, explaining why the app uses it, that it is optional, and what happens without it

resources.string: Sky Map använder din ungefärliga plats för att visa rätt natthimmel. Denna behörighet är valfri — du kan neka den och istället ange din plats manuellt, eller bestämma dig senare. Om du bestämmer dig senare kommer kartan inte att vara korrekt förrän din plats har ställts in.
Platsbehörighet nekades permanent. Öppna appinställningar för att aktivera det igen.

string.name: location_latitude_hint
string.translation_description: Floating label above the latitude input field. Kept short so it doesn't wrap next to the N/S hemisphere toggle.

string.name: location_latitude_placeholder
string.translation_description: Example value shown in the latitude field before the user types anything; disappears once they start typing. The sign is set by a separate N/S toggle, so this is always a positive number.

string.name: location_longitude_hint
string.translation_description: Floating label above the longitude input field. Kept short so it doesn't wrap next to the E/W hemisphere toggle.

string.name: location_longitude_placeholder
string.translation_description: Example value shown in the longitude field before the user types anything; disappears once they start typing. The sign is set by a separate E/W toggle, so this is always a positive number.

resources.string: Plats hittades inte – försök med ett mer specifikt namn
Ingen geokodningstjänst på den här enheten – ange koordinater direkt

string.name: location_geocoder_failed
string.translation_description: Inline message shown when place name lookup fails for a reason other than being offline or the place not existing

string.name: location_hemisphere_north_description
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the latitude hemisphere toggle button, selected for a positive value

string.name: location_hemisphere_south_description
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the latitude hemisphere toggle button, selected for a negative value

string.name: location_hemisphere_east_description
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the longitude hemisphere toggle button, selected for a positive value

string.name: location_hemisphere_west_description
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the longitude hemisphere toggle button, selected for a negative value
